name: Silverbrook River
description: Downstream from the docks, the river widens. Crabs and frogs inhabit the muddy banks.
visualTheme: A wide, fast-flowing river with reeds, clay beds, and large stones protruding from the water.

history.createdWhy: Flows from the northern peaks, carving the silverbrook canyon.
history.majorEvents: Initial mapping by Silverbrook guild cartographers.
history.whyExists: Vital fresh water source and breeding ground for trout and carp.
history.currentConflicts: Spawns mud sprites that flood the banks with sticky clay.
